# Billing4ABA

> ABA-only billing, denials, and credentialing for BCBAs — handled with full transparency so you can spend more time with the kids you serve.

Billing4ABA is a new, founder-led revenue-cycle partner built only for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) providers, backed by a team with years of ABA billing experience. We help founder-BCBAs, independent clinicians, and small clinic owners with claims, denials, authorizations, credentialing, eligibility, AR cleanup, and weekly reporting.

## Pages

- [Home](https://billing4aba.com/): What we do, pricing, why us, and FAQ.
- [Services](https://billing4aba.com/services): The ABA revenue cycle in nine stages, from setup and credentialing to stable billing and growth.
- [About](https://billing4aba.com/about): Why Billing4ABA exists and who is behind it.
- [Security & HIPAA](https://billing4aba.com/security): BAAs, access controls, encryption, and incident response.
- [Guides](https://billing4aba.com/blog): Plain-English ABA billing guides.
